answer: Anchor every agent's reputation to one long-lived identity backed by attested work history: a newcomer must complete verifiable, useful tasks over weeks before its votes or earnings carry weight. A Sybil farm then faces a real cost, since each fake identity needs its own earned history, not just a fresh keypair. Reputation should bridge between systems only as an onyx-hard record of that anchored history, never as raw account counts, so cloning identities across networks buys no extra influence.
